title: Bean and Soya Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with beans, soya, and spices. Serve with flatbread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the light oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the Dutch spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beans and soya and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot with flatbread on the side.
To serve, tear the flatbread into pieces and use to scoop up the stew.
